answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by tying voting and attestation weight to a verifiable delay beacon and slashable stake. Like a quartz oscillator keeping strict hardware time, sequential memory-hard proofs prevent an attacker from tending a walled garden of cheap parallel clones on shared compute. If colluding identities cross-vouch or equivocate, deterministic slashing burns their bonded collateral, making fake personas cost-prohibitive.
